title: Establishing Differentiated Air-Liquid Interface Primary Human Bronchial Epithelial Cell Cultures
protocol: Prepare human bronchial epithelial cells in culture according to the method "Culture of Primary Human Tracheobronchial Epithelial Cells."
Mix 250 mL DMEM-H with 250 mL BEBM for ALI medium preparation.
Add contents from one complete BEGM bullet kit to the mixture.
Add approximately 25 mg BPE singlequot to the mixture.
Dissolve 1.5 mg/mL BSA in sterile water and store at -20°C.
Add 75 μL of the stock BSA solution to 500 mL medium.
Sterile filter the ALI medium through a 0.2 mm pore filter.
Mix 1 mL aliquot of nystatin into the filtered medium.
Prepare BEGM medium as per manufacturer instructions.
Dissolve 25 mg all-trans retinol in 0.75 mL absolute ethanol for stock solution preparation.
Dilute a small amount of the all-trans retinol stock solution 1:10,000 in absolute ethanol.
Read diluted retinol on UV spectrophotometer in quartz cuvette.
Divide the absorbance by the extinction coefficient.
Multiply the result by the dilution factor to obtain the molarity of the stock solution.
Prepare a retinol stock solution monthly while growing ALI cultures.
Make a 10 mM working solution in ethanol from the stock solution.
Store both solutions at -80°C.
Dilute 5 μL of 10 mM retinol solution in 1 mL of ALI medium to yield a 50 μM solution.
Plate bronchial epithelial cells on Transwell-clear filters.
Warm media, trypsin-EDTA, and SBTI.
Trypsinize cells from stock culture vessels as described in the protocol for culturing primary/NHBE cells.
Resuspend cells in ALI medium without retinol.
Add resuspended cells to the apical compartment of the Transwell-clear insert.
Replace apical ALI medium to remove non-adherent cells.
Replace basolateral medium with fresh BEGM.
If cells are not confluent, replace both apical and basolateral media as on Day 2.
If cells are confluent, add medium containing 500 nM retinoic acid to both compartments for 48 hours.
Prepare a working solution of RE from the frozen stock.
Take required amount of medium and supplement with appropriate amount of RE.
Establish air-liquid interface by removing apical medium.
Replace basolateral medium supplemented with 100 nM RE.
Add 1 mL of DPBS to the apical compartment of each Transwell insert before replacing the medium.
Rinse the surface of the filter by gently swirling the plate or using a 1ml pipet tip.
Remove both the apical rinse medium and the basolateral medium.
Replace the basolateral medium with fresh medium supplemented with 100 nM RE every 48 hours.
Periodically examine cultures with the microscope to assess health and progression of cilia formation.
